import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import protocols, plistlib, struct

def frame(d):
    b = plistlib.dumps(d, fmt=plistlib.FMT_XML)
    return struct.pack('>I', len(b)) + b

good = frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'1.2.3'}) + frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'X,Y'})
print(protocols.signature('sync', good))
# binary plist variant + trailing data + dup keys + wrong key + empty value + nonstr
import plistlib as pl
def bframe(d):
    b = pl.dumps(d, fmt=pl.FMT_BINARY); return struct.pack('>I', len(b))+b
print(protocols.signature('sync', bframe({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'9'}) + bframe({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'Z'})))
print(protocols.signature('sync', good + b'x'))
print(protocols.signature('sync', good[:-1]))
print(protocols.signature('sync', frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':''}) + frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'Z'})))
print(protocols.signature('sync', frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'a','Extra':1}) + frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'Z'})))
# duplicate keys in XML -> last wins?
dup = b'<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><plist><dict><key>Key</key><string>ProductVersion</string><key>Key</key><string>ProductName</string><key>Request</key><string>GetValue</string><key>Value</key><string>q</string></dict></plist>'
print('dup:', protocols.signature('sync', struct.pack('>I', len(dup))+dup + frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'Z'})))
# ADB AUTH
p = protocols.adb_packet(protocols.AUTH, 1, 2, b'\x00\xff')
print(protocols.signature('adb', p))
# CNXN bad utf8
p2 = protocols.adb_packet(protocols.CNXN, 0x01020300, 4096, b'\xff\xfe')
print(protocols.signature('adb', p2))
p3 = protocols.adb_packet(protocols.CNXN, 0x01020300, 4096, 'héllo'.encode())
